author: blu
body: Launches the full graphical UI from the dev console. Transitions from UEFI text mode to GOP framebuffer mode, initializes the UI orchestrator, and enters the graphical shell.

author: val
body: UEFI Graphics Output Protocol: SystemTable->BootServices->LocateProtocol yields EFI_GRAPHICS_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL; GOP->SetMode(mode) switches to the framebuffer; GOP->Mode->FrameBufferBase is its physical address; GOP->Mode->Info carries HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution and PixelsPerScanLine.
